name: tcpmany
description: The anti-goal check of the net-mux design (section 6): more TCP connections open at once than the W5100 has sockets.  loopprobe -m listens on lo0 with a backlog of 5; a child opens 16 connections and holds them all, then each carries 1 KB both ways, byte-checked; MANY OK.  The chip's four sockets, net.mod's twelve descriptors or NPIPE's eight rings would each stop it.  The modules load at boot (/etc/rc).
